author: Kelin Studio
description: Sheet music, MIDI and isolated stems for songs from GrooveSheet's library of AI transcriptions, in any MCP app. Remote server, no sign-in.
name: GrooveSheet

tools.name: search_songs
tools.title: Search GrooveSheet songs
tools.description:
Search GrooveSheet's public library of AI-transcribed songs by title or artist.

Returns up to 10 songs per page with id, title, artist, the separated
instruments, whether the song has sheet music / MIDI / stems, and the song
page URL. Track-level flags only: call get_song for which specific parts are
scored, since a song can have sheet music for one part and only MIDI for another.

query.description: Song title and/or artist, e.g. 'Easy On Me Adele'.
query.title: Query

instrument.description: Only songs with this part: drums, piano, bass, guitar, vocals or other.
instrument.title: Instrument

format.description: Only songs offering this format. 'sheet' = readable sheet music (MusicXML/PDF), 'midi' = MIDI transcription, 'stems' = isolated audio. With an instrument, 'sheet' and 'midi' are checked for that specific part.
format.title: Format

tools.name: get_song
tools.title: Get GrooveSheet song details
tools.description:
Details for one GrooveSheet song: every part and what notation it has.

Each part is `sheet_music` (readable score, PDF, Guitar Pro), `midi_only`
(MIDI transcription, no score) or `audio_only` (isolated stem). Includes the
song page URL and, for each scored part, its sheet music page.

track_id.description: Track id (UUID) or slug from search_songs, e.g. 'easy-on-me-adele-0fff6be3'.
track_id.title: Track Id

tools.name: get_download_links
tools.title: Get GrooveSheet download links
tools.description:
Links for one part of a GrooveSheet library song, to hand to the user.

Always returns the song page. For a part with sheet music it adds the sheet
music page and direct PDF and Guitar Pro links, which work without an
account. Stem audio, MIDI and MusicXML downloads need a free GrooveSheet
account on the song page; this tool does not return raw file URLs for them.

track_id.description: Track id (UUID) or slug from search_songs.
track_id.title: Track Id

instrument.description: Part to get: drums, piano, bass, guitar, vocals or other.
instrument.title: Instrument
